title: Noise Complaint (Residential)
description: Use this service request to report noise complaints of a chronic or reoccurring nature, i.e. continuous complaints about loud music/disturbances at a residential property. **Do not use to report noisy animals, construction noise or noise issues at clubs/bars. See Animal - Noisy or Code Concern ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days. *** Call 9-1-1 if this is the first-time reporting the location or if the noise is occurring now ***

detailsForm.intro: ***Be advised that this service request is not monitored on a 24-hour basis. If you have an emergency and require immediate assistance, please call 911.***

conditionalPaths.instruction: Oops, if this is the first time reporting loud noise at this residence please call 9-1-1 to report. Use only if it reoccurs often at same location..

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about recurring noise at a residence.
actions.why: To report chronic or recurring noise at the same residential location, such as ongoing loud music or disturbances. The 311 request form asks whether the problem recurs, what the noise is, and which days or times it occurs.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Noise Complaint (Residential)" requests does not apply to noisy animals, construction noise, noise at clubs or bars, a first-time report at a location, or noise occurring now. If the concern is construction noise or noise at a club or bar, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead. If the concern is a noisy animal, then view the "Animal - Noisy" 311 guidance instead. If this is the first report at that location, then call 911 instead of submitting a 311 request online. If the noise is occurring now, then call 911 instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Noise Complaint (Residential)"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Noise Complaint (Residential)"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for construction noise or noise at a club or bar directed to Code Concerns.
actions.why: For construction noise or noise issues at clubs or bars. The description for "Noise Complaint (Residential)" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs these concerns to Code Concern; the "Code Concerns" 311 request covers nuisance complaints including noise.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Call 911 for a first-time noise report at a residence.
actions.why: For the first report of loud noise at a residential location. The description for "Noise Complaint (Residential)" requests on the Dallas 311 website and the 311 request form direct first-time reports to 911.
For noise that is occurring now at a residence. The description for "Noise Complaint (Residential)" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs currently occurring noise to 911.

actions.tagline: View Dallas 311 guidance for noisy animals.
actions.why: For a noisy-animal concern rather than recurring noise from music or other residential activity. The description for "Noise Complaint (Residential)" requests on the Dallas 311 website names "Animal - Noisy" as an alternate service.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 and look for "Animal - Noisy" guidance
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) and look for "Animal - Noisy" guidance
